The '''Solloops system''' was a part of the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay in the [[Arrowhead]] region within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Solloops hairstyles/Legends|solloops hairstyles]].<ref name="TCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Solloops hairstyles/Legends|solloops hairstyles]]|system=Solloops [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Solloops [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-10.<ref name="TEA" />
